title: Decide and propose: how a refusal reason is named (URI like RFC 9457 type, or a registered code) and its IANA registry
description: For the UpdateRoomResponse (and keyMaterial) refusal reason extension. Options: (1) a URI naming the condition, matching proposal 13 (RFC 9457 problem types for HTTP errors); (2) a small integer from a new IANA registry. Must carry no English. Should settle #206 (notAllowed vs invalidProposal for a policy-invalid Commit) by letting the reason say which rule. Initial reasons from the table: room-policy §3 roles_list beside participant change; Commit leaves out cached §3.5 proposals; wrong epoch; capability missing (role N lacks X); From domain is not the proposer's. Needs Mark's decision, then a draft PR.
close_reason: Mark, 2026-11-15: URI. A refusal reason is a URI naming the condition, as RFC 9457 problem types are (matches #204). Proposal for the spec: URNs under an IETF-registered namespace, urn:ietf:params:mimi:reason:<name> (RFC 3553), with an IANA registry of names; implementations may also use their own URIs (e.g. tag: or https:) for local reasons, and a receiver that doesn't know one treats the response by its result code alone. mimid until the WG decides: tag:reviewcommit.com,2026:mimid:reason:<name>, alongside its existing tag: problem types (src/http.rs PROBLEM_TYPE_PREFIX), marked INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC.
